job.value: check the AI-filled card details and list it

arrivedFrom.value: the camera or card scanner (retired variant, nothing links here now)

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Listing 1' with 'Graded Singles', 'Charizard — Base Set (1999)' and 'PSA 10' prefilled reads as a card listing to confirm.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'List it' at the bottom is the dominant control.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Most labels predict, but 'Post all ›' and 'List it' coexist for a single item without saying which does what.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Grade', 'PSA 10', 'Card number' and 'Set' are terms a card seller uses, and 'Fixed price (beta)' is explained by 'Buyers can only purchase at the listed price'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Card attributes come prefilled ('Charizard', '4/102', 'Base Set') and price shows 'Suggested: S$85.00 – S$120.00'.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: 'Deal method and payment' is collapsed, but the 'Optional details' section is expanded by default and shows six optional fields to everyone.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every section serves listing this card.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and values carry the form; the only text lines are short hints like 'Choose a template'.
